model: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), Claude Cowork, effort max

B_identity.note: kernel integral (Polymath normalization) against the Gaussian average E[xi(w + tau N)] of Lemma 3.1; two independent routes to S(x,p,t)

E_bound_vs_gain.note: zeta mode at height T = 1e9; gain = (kappa(sigma_0) - kappa(sigma_0 + tau^2 ell/2))/2 only; the family floor also gains (1/4)(psi((sigma_*+a)/2) - psi((sigma_0+a)/2)) at x = 0, not counted here

F_lemma_Ap_floors.note: H(t) sampled at ell_*^{(0)} + {0,1,3}; monotonicity in ell is checked numerically in section E's tables, not proved

G_strip_comparison_heat_floor.note: planning values: conditional on H12 and on a written comparison theorem (Project 01, Section 3.5); the heat floor H(t) is the proved bound of the note evaluated in floating point; lambda = time for Q to reach 0 (b -> 0)

H_thresholds.note: thresholds use the 20-point grid TFINE (0.001 <= t <= 0.5); below t = 0.001 the margin is tau^2 times the small-t coefficient plus O(tau^3), the latter not bounded here; the conductor thresholds sample ell at ell_*^(0) only (monotonicity in ell is the separate check E_monotone_in_ell)
